Name: Romanceable Rasmodius Map Replacer
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][u][b][i][color=#fce5cd]Romanceable Rasmodius Map Replacer[/color][/i][/b]

[/u][/size][size=3]Hoorah it's finally been released! The title is self-explanatory so I won't make this long fortunately for you :p
[/size]
[size=3]Installation works as a replacer since I'm not techie enough to figure some stuff out, but it's a small inconvenience. Overwrite the original mod! If you don't know what you're doing, I suggest not fiddling with it too much. If Yoba forbid you [i]do[/i] open the folder, just make sure to include [b]everything[/b].
Oh, and you need Extra Map Layers.
[/size]
[size=3]If you have my other mod [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442][size=3]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/size][/url][i][size=3] [/size][size=1][b](shameless plug)[/b][/size][/i][size=3], make sure to turn the [/size][u][b][size=3]"[color=#cfe2f3]Wizards Tower[/color]" = [color=#e06666]OFF[/color][/size][/b][/u][size=3] in the config![/size]

[size=3]Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2421870?tab=user+files]WerewolfMaster[/url] for giving me permission to republish my personal map edit from their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]﻿ mod. Go check it out! While I haven't played through it fully [/size][size=1][b][i](Imagine actually playing and not just hoarding mods for hours on end)[/i][/b][/size][size=3], it has been given a lot of love and I can assure that you can enjoy it. [/size]

[size=3]Also, with great portrait mods out there, who doesn't like a hot wizard? [/size]

[size=3]This has the [s]most simplest coding[/s] [u](Did no coding besides on the map itself)[/u] that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][b][size=3]AFTER[/size][/b][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted![/size]
